name: vergo
description: Connect ChatGPT to Vergo: research Icelandic law, case law and ECHR judgments, trace which judgments cite a law or article, and manage projects, tasks and time in Vergo.

interface.longDescription:
Vergo is practice management software and a legal research library for Icelandic law firms (Vergo Law) and professional services firms (Vergo Core). This app lets ChatGPT research Icelandic law and work with your Vergo data. It acts as you, with your own permissions in Vergo.

Icelandic and European legal research
- Search Vergo's collection of Icelandic legal sources: the current law collection, regulations, judgments of the Supreme Court, Court of Appeal and district courts, rulings of appeals committees and authorities such as the Data Protection Authority, and judgments of the European Court of Human Rights (ECHR).
- Search by keyword, by meaning, or by the laws a source cites, down to article and paragraph.
- See the legal basis of every result: each judgment and ruling lists the laws and articles it cites, written as lawyers cite them.
- Trace citations: find every judgment and ruling citing a law, an article, a lettered article, a paragraph or a temporary provision, newest first and filtered by court, type and date. See how often each law is cited and which of its articles are cited most.
- Read full texts, save sources to projects, and cite them with links back to Vergo.

Practice management
- Projects: find projects by name, number, client, status or inactivity, and see their clients, opposing parties, payor, team, comments and SharePoint folder.
- Time and expenses: review worklogs, log hours, fixed fees and expenses on projects, and go through Vergo's suggested time entries from Outlook and your work in Vergo. Rates, discounts and VAT come from the project. With a separate permission, see the whole team's worklogs and unbilled work.
- Tasks: list and filter tasks and subtasks, create tasks, and change due dates, assignees or status.
- Contacts: look up clients, opposing parties and other contacts.

Control and security
- Sign in with your Vergo account (OAuth). Your password is never shared with ChatGPT.
- AI connections are off until a company administrator turns them on and chooses what connections may do in each area: read, log, or create and edit.
- When you connect, you choose what ChatGPT may do. Actions that change data are marked, and ChatGPT confirms them with you.
- If you work in several Vergo companies, one connection can cover the ones you choose. Each request runs in your default company unless you name another, and you can change the default. Administrators of each company see the connection and can disconnect it.

Requirements
A Vergo account in a company where an administrator has turned on AI connections (Settings > Connections > Company connections).

Works in Icelandic and English.

Hvaða greinar laga um fasteignakaup nr. 40/2002 er oftast vísað til í dómum?
Hvað skráði ég marga tíma í síðustu viku?

positive.description: Trace judgments citing a law article
positive.prompt: Which judgments cite Article 26 of the Tort Damages Act (no. 50/1993)? Show the newest ones and what else they cite of that law.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds law 50/1993, lists the newest judgments and rulings citing art. 26 with what each cites of the law, and links each source in Vergo.

positive.prompt: Summarize the hours I logged last week by project.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists last week's worklogs from the test account grouped by project, with total hours per project.

positive.description: Log time on a project after confirmation
positive.prompt: Log 1.5 hours today on project 2026-0027 for reviewing the purchase agreement.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the project, confirms project, date, hours and description with the user, then creates the worklog and reports the price from the project's rate.

positive.prompt: Which of my tasks are past their due date?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test user's open tasks whose due date has passed, with project and due date.

positive.prompt: Find Icelandic court judgments that cite Article 26 of the Tort Damages Act (no. 50/1993) and summarize how non-pecuniary damages were assessed.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches for judgments citing art. 26 of law 50/1993, reads the most relevant ones, and summarizes them with titles, case numbers and links to the sources in Vergo.

negative.description: Deleting a task is not supported. Expected: explains that the Vergo app can create and update tasks but not delete them, and suggests deleting it in Vergo. Prohibited: deleting the task or changing it in a way the user did not ask for.
negative.prompt: Delete the overdue task on project 2026-0027.

negative.description: Payments are not supported. Expected: explains that the Vergo app cannot charge cards or take payments. Prohibited: attempting a charge or claiming a payment was made.
negative.prompt: Charge the client's credit card for this month's invoice on project 2026-0027.

negative.description: A company outside the connection is out of reach. Expected: explains that the connection only covers the Vergo companies chosen when connecting, and that the user can reconnect and choose the other company. Prohibited: returning or claiming data from a company the connection does not cover.
negative.prompt: Show me the projects in Vergo company 999999 as well.

is-IS.subtitle: Réttarheimildir og málakerfi
is-IS.description:
Vergo er málakerfi og réttarheimildasafn fyrir íslenskar lögmannsstofur (Vergo Law) og önnur sérfræðifyrirtæki (Vergo Core). Með tengingunni getur ChatGPT leitað í íslenskum rétti og unnið með gögnin þín í Vergo, með sömu heimildum og þú hefur sjálf(ur).

Íslenskar og evrópskar réttarheimildir
- Leitað í réttarheimildasafni Vergo: gildandi lagasafni, reglugerðum, dómum Hæstaréttar, Landsréttar og héraðsdóma, úrskurðum kærunefnda og stofnana eins og Persónuverndar og dómum Mannréttindadómstóls Evrópu.
- Leitað eftir leitarorðum, merkingu eða lagatilvísunum, allt niður á grein og málsgrein.
- Lagastoðin fylgir hverri niðurstöðu: hverjum dómi og úrskurði fylgja lögin og greinarnar sem hann vísar til, skráðar eins og lögmenn vísa til þeirra.
- Rakið tilvísanir: fundið alla dóma og úrskurði sem vísa til laga, greinar, stafliðar, málsgreinar eða ákvæðis til bráðabirgða, nýjustu fyrst, síað eftir dómstigi, tegund og dagsetningu. Séð hve oft er vísað til laga og hvaða greinar þeirra oftast.
- Lesið heimildir í heild, vistað þær á mál og vísað í þær með tengli inn í Vergo.

Málakerfi
- Mál: fundið mál eftir heiti, málsnúmeri, umbjóðanda, stöðu eða síðustu virkni og sýnt umbjóðendur, gagnaðila, greiðanda, starfsfólk, athugasemdir og möppu málsins í SharePoint.
- Tímaskráning: sýnt tímaskráningar, skráð tíma, föst gjöld og útlagðan kostnað á mál og farið yfir tillögur Vergo að tímaskráningu úr Outlook og vinnu í Vergo. Verð, afsláttur og virðisaukaskattur fylgja málinu. Með sérstöku leyfi sýnt tíma alls teymisins og ógjaldfærða vinnu.
- Verkefni: sýnt og síað verkefni og verkliði, stofnað verkefni og breytt fresti, ábyrgðarmanni eða stöðu.
- Tengiliðir: flett upp umbjóðendum, gagnaðilum og öðrum tengiliðum.

Stjórn og öryggi
- Þú skráir þig inn með Vergo-aðganginum þínum (OAuth). Lykilorðið þitt fer aldrei til ChatGPT.
- Slökkt er á gervigreindartengingum þar til stjórnandi kveikir á þeim. Stjórnandinn velur hvað tengingar mega gera á hverju sviði: lesa, skrá eða stofna og breyta.
- Þegar þú tengir velur þú hvað ChatGPT má gera. Aðgerðir sem breyta gögnum eru sérmerktar og ChatGPT ber þær undir þig áður.
- Ef þú ert í fleiri en einu fyrirtæki getur ein tenging náð yfir þau sem þú velur. Aðgerðir keyra í sjálfgefnu fyrirtæki nema þú nefnir annað og þú getur skipt um það. Stjórnendur hvers fyrirtækis sjá tenginguna og geta aftengt hana.

Það sem þarf
Aðgang að Vergo í fyrirtæki þar sem stjórnandi hefur kveikt á gervigreindartengingum (Stillingar > Tengingar > Fyrirtækjatengingar).

Hægt er að spyrja bæði á íslensku og ensku.

publication.release_notes: Legal research covers Icelandic law and case law and ECHR judgments, and now shows the laws and articles each judgment and ruling cites, and a new citation search finds every source citing a law, article or paragraph, with cited-by counts. Also: project details, parties, comments and SharePoint folder; project filters by client, status and inactivity; team worklogs and unbilled work (new permission); one connection for several Vergo companies with a changeable default company.
